method: Fresh process per sample, one warmup; solve includes lazy permutation generation, filtering and copying solutions; excludes parsing, setup and board output. Every run must exactly match an independent exhaustive oracle over all 40320 permutations.

definitions.unique:
fun safe Q rank 1
  Up = Q + Columns unique len
  if Up not equal 8
    return false
  end
  return Q - Columns unique len equal 8
end
definitions.adjacent-unique:
fun safe Q rank 1
  for I in 0 till 7
    if (Q I - Q (I + 1)) abs equal 1
      return false
    end
  end
  Up = Q + Columns unique len
  if Up not equal 8
    return false
  end
  return Q - Columns unique len equal 8
end
definitions.outer-count:
Dy = Columns Columns outer - abs copy
fun safe Q rank 1
  Dx = Q Q outer - abs
  return (Dx equal Dy) count equal 8
end
definitions.outer-any:
Dy = Columns Columns outer - abs copy
Different = Dy greater 0 copy
fun safe Q rank 1
  Dx = Q Q outer - abs
  Hit = Dx equal Dy and Different
  return not (Hit any)
end
definitions.pairs:
Pairs = Columns 2 combinations array
I = Pairs # 0 copy
J = Pairs # 1 copy
Distances = J - I copy
fun safe Q rank 1
  Dx = (Q I - Q J) abs
  return (Dx not equal Distances) all
end
definitions.shifts:
fun safe Q rank 1
  for D in 1 till 8
    Left = Q (0 till (8 - D) array)
    Right = Q (D till 8 array)
    if ((Left - Right) abs equal D) any
      return false
    end
  end
  return true
end
definitions.shifts-hoisted:
LeftIndices = tuple (0 till 7 array) (0 till 6 array) (0 till 5 array) (0 till 4 array) (0 till 3 array) (0 till 2 array) (0 till 1 array)
RightIndices = tuple (1 till 8 array) (2 till 8 array) (3 till 8 array) (4 till 8 array) (5 till 8 array) (6 till 8 array) (7 till 8 array)
fun safe Q rank 1
  for D in 1 till 8
    Left = Q (LeftIndices (D - 1))
    Right = Q (RightIndices (D - 1))
    if ((Left - Right) abs equal D) any
      return false
    end
  end
  return true
end
definitions.rank:
Offsets = (array -1 1) Columns outer * copy
fun distinct A rank 1
  return A unique len equal 8
end
fun safe Q rank 1
  Diags = Offsets + Q
  return Diags distinct rank 1 all
end
definitions.scalar:
fun safe Q rank 1
  for I in 0 till 7
    for J in I + 1 till 8
      if (Q I - Q J) abs equal J - I
        return false
      end
    end
  end
  return true
end
definitions.scalar-distance:
fun safe Q rank 1
  for D in 1 till 8
    for I in 0 till (8 - D)
      if (Q I - Q (I + D)) abs equal D
        return false
      end
    end
  end
  return true
end
definitions.scalar-signed:
fun safe Q rank 1
  for D in 1 till 8
    for I in 0 till (8 - D)
      Delta = Q I - Q (I + D)
      if Delta equal D or Delta equal -D
        return false
      end
    end
  end
  return true
end
